corrected_torso_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: replacement torso artwork for an eight-direction detailed 2D student animation puppet. Reference image1 is the user's full-body character design. Image2 is the existing front cutout sheet. Image3 is the existing profile cutout sheet, showing the mistake we must fix: its torso includes a sleeve even though the rig has separate arms. Create a NEW atlas containing ONLY EIGHT CORRECT TORSOS for this same 18-year-old student, preserving his ochre jacket, cream button shirt, lapels, pockets, student ID, stitching, and leather shoulder strap.
CRITICAL: the TORSOS MUST HAVE NO ARMS AND NO SLEEVES. NO sleeve caps, NO rolled cuffs, NO elbows, NO hands. The jacket sleeves are separately animated pieces and will be added later. Render the coat body like a fitted sleeveless vest with small unobtrusive open armholes at the sides of its shoulder line. Torso begins at the open shirt collar, ends at the coat hem just below the trouser belt, and contains NO head, NO skin neck, NO pelvis, NO legs, NO bag. No empty long sleeve shapes hidden behind the body. The torso silhouette is anatomically shaped ribs/waist/shoulders only. Front shoulders are broad enough to accept separate sleeve joints. Direct profile torsos must be genuinely NARROW side views, not three-quarter views.
Genuine alpha transparency, no background or shadow, no labels or grid lines. Landscape 2048x1024 sheet, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equal square cells, ONE isolated torso centred in each cell with generous transparent margins. All torsos have the same physical scale and height, collar baseline and hem baseline aligned. Hand-painted illustrated style with clean dark outlines and shaded cloth, adult proportions, matching images1 and2 exactly.
Row1 left-to-right:
cell0 FRONT facing viewer (south), cream shirt, ID, buttons visible.
cell1 THREE-QUARTER FRONT looking LEFT (south-west).
cell2 STRICT LEFT PROFILE looking LEFT (west), NO extra arm or sleeve, narrow jacket body only.
cell3 THREE-QUARTER BACK looking LEFT (north-west), back of jacket, no shirt front or ID.
Row2 left-to-right:
cell4 DIRECT BACK (north), back of jacket only, no front lapels or ID.
cell5 THREE-QUARTER BACK looking RIGHT (north-east).
cell6 STRICT RIGHT PROFILE looking RIGHT (east), NO extra arm or sleeve, narrow jacket body only.
cell7 THREE-QUARTER FRONT looking RIGHT (south-east).
The shoulder strap hangs from the wearer's ANATOMICAL RIGHT shoulder down toward his RIGHT hip as in the original full-body reference, retaining the correct side in every view: viewer-left in front and viewer-right in back. There is no messenger bag in these torso images. Every cell contains only the torso. Inspect the sides of every torso and REMOVE ALL sleeve-shaped protrusions.
